title: Alterations under a 1998 consent: CCC refused under the 1998 Code (Auckland)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
authority: Auckland Council (successor to North Shore City Council)
code_edition: NZ Building Code in force January 1998 (App. A, p.30)
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Two-storey detached dwelling built in 1967 on a large, gently sloping site in a low wind zone; 1998 consent covered garage enclosure, first- and ground-floor extensions, a large deck and a tiled entrance roof.
Cladding is a mix that includes monolithic EIFS (modified acrylic plaster over expanded polystyrene) and other systems.
Determination applies the Building Code in force in January 1998; Appendix A quotes B2 Durability and related clauses.
Decision: authority correct to refuse the CCC for the 1998 consent; decision modified to remove the non-compliance references for the entrance canopy roof and the laundry toilet installation.
